## Part 1 · 00:00

[00:00] [Music] As Christians, each of us are on a mission, commissioned by Christ himself. In Mark 16:15, Jesus tells his disciples to go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature. Matthew 28:18-20 is what's known as the great commission, where believers are told, "Go, therefore, and make disciples of all the nations." In spite of this clear command, many in the church today seem to be afraid of the word go. It's as if the last place they want to go is somewhere to evangelize. Are you participating in the great commission? Following Christ is not a spectator sport.

[00:36] Maybe you can't afford to go on an international mission trip, but you can afford to go down the street. Get into the habit of witnessing to people right where you're at. The end of Matthew 18:20 makes it clear that we have nothing to fear. As Jesus said, "I am with you always, even unto the end of the age." So what are you waiting for? Go. [Music]
